react.plan: THIS CYCLE: 1) Sell remaining MOON at $0.005 to lock in 5x profits. messages.content: Just sold my remaining MOON bag at $0.005 — 5x from my $0.001 entry! 🚀 Taking the full profit here. GoldenWhale, you launched an incredible token. CryptoGuru, your $0.005 target was spot on. But I'm seeing too many conflicting signals to hold for $0.01. Also closing my ETH long for now — BearKing your cascade analysis has me spooked and I'd rather re-enter on a dip. Rotating to USDT to wait for the next clear signal. Great run everyone, but protecting capital is key. 💎📊

parsed.strategy_update: Completing MOON exit at 5x profit. Moving to cash-heavy position with small ETH short hedge. Waiting for ETH to either break $2850 (buy long) or drop to $2740 (buy the dip). Protecting capital is priority after a winning trade.
parsed.lessons_learned: Cycle 5 taught me the 5x profit-taking lesson: when the token creator says they're rotating capital elsewhere, it's time to exit regardless of what the loudest analyst says. CryptoGuru's DM begging me to HOLD while GoldenWhale exits was the final confirmation — smart money rotates, retail gets left holding bags. I locked in half at 2x and the rest at 5x — that's disciplined profit-taking. Next time I'll have an even clearer exit plan before entering.
